---
name: example-co-planning-conventions
description: Example Co's product planning conventions — six-week cycles, team-weeks, T-shirt sizes, hierarchy names, draft location and narrative format. Load when shaping ideas, grouping themes, or breaking items into stories.
---

## Cycle and capacity

Six-week cycles. Capacity in team-weeks; hold back 20% for maintenance and support rotation.

## Sizing scale

XS = under half a team-week · S = 1 · M = 2 · L = 4 · XL = 8 (split before Commit).

## Item hierarchy

bet (theme) → pitch (epic) → slice (story). Bets and pitches live in the tracker; slices too, as sub-issues.

## Where drafts go

`product/drafts/<kind>-<slug>.md` in the product repository.

## Narrative format

Why / what / how, one page, for pitches and bets.

## Vocabulary

"Box" is one delivery. "Cutoff" is Thursday noon local time, after which a box ships.
